levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن شبوية المروزي

notes: Three taḥwīl branches (ح) meet at الزهري; the names written once after the last ح (الزهري، حميد، أمه) form the shared tail, so the first branch stops at سفيان.
وقال أحمد بن محمد ومسدد is a pure wording variant of the same saying and is left out.
The editor gloss between dashes is not in the surfaces.
